feeds.what: every contest of the election in one document, with statewide and per-county totals ('Election Results XML Feed' on the page)
feeds.notes: IEEE 1622.2 / NIST election results reporting XML (root <ElectionReport xmlns="http://grouper.ieee.org/groups/1622/groups/2/V1/1622_2-election_results_reporting.xsd" Format="SummaryContest" Status="UnofficialComplete" VendorApplicationId="Ohio-ENR 1.0.02">). Served as text/plain, Cache-Control: max-age=15, with ETag and Last-Modified (Tue, 10 Nov 2026 23:31:14 GMT), gzip. No election id in the URL: it is always the current election. Relational: Contest/BallotSelection holds VoteCounts (first one is the Statewide GpUnit, then one per county after a <!--begin county totals--> comment) and CandidateId(s); names come from Election/CandidateCollection/Candidate/BallotName, joined via PersonId/PartyId to PersonCollection and PartyCollection. The site documents the format at https://liveresults.ohiosos.gov/Content/PDF/P1622Documentation.pdf (not fetched). Other filenames the page offers through the same endpoint: GeneralElectionXlsFile and EMSReporting<name>Results (spreadsheets, not fetched).

election_id: None in the URL. In the document: <Election Date="2026-11-03" Type="General"> with Name "November 3, 2026 General Unofficial Canvass".
discovery: Nothing to discover: the same URL always serves the current election; read Election/@Date in the document to know which one. No elections list was found.
bot_blocking: None seen: 200 with the relay User-Agent (Cloudflare in front, cf-cache-status DYNAMIC, no challenge). CAVEAT about this machine only: Git Bash curl 8.8.0 (Schannel) dies on this host with 'curl: (43) A libcurl function was given a bad argument' (same as North Dakota's hosts), so the page, the XML and the .headers.txt were fetched with Python urllib sending the relay User-Agent and Origin header; the headers file was written by that script, not curl -D. Browser User-Agent not needed, not tried.
updated_field: Root attribute GeneratedDate="2026-11-10T11:30:51Z". WARNING: it looks like a 12-hour clock written without AM/PM and labelled Z: the HTTP Last-Modified on the same response was Tue, 10 Nov 2026 23:31:14 GMT, so 11:30:51 is almost certainly 23:30:51 UTC. Prefer the Last-Modified header (or ETag) for change detection.
reporting_field: Per county, on GpUnit elements with Type="County" and IsElectoralDistrict="false": SubUnitsReported / TotalSubUnits (precincts), e.g. <GpUnit … Name="Adams" SubUnitsReported="21" TotalSubUnits="21" Type="County" VotersParticipated="9169" VotersRegistered="17079">, with a child <CountStatus Status="Completed" Type="Total"/>. There is no per-contest or statewide precinct figure; sum the 88 counties (the Statewide GpUnit has no counts).

other_statewide: Justice of the Supreme Court (two contests share this exact Name; tell them apart by ObjectId / SequenceOrder 05500000 and 05750000)
measures: State Issue 3 To require voters to present photo identification in order to vote (Abbreviation "State Issue 3"; the only statewide issue in the file)

choice_format: Indirect. <BallotSelection xsi:type="CandidateSelection" IsWriteIn="false"> has <VoteCounts Type="Total" Count="2404178"><GpUnitId>…</GpUnitId></VoteCounts> and one or two <CandidateId> (two for the governor ticket: governor, then lieutenant governor with a _CO prefix). The candidate is <Candidate ObjectId=…><BallotName><LanguageString Language="en">Munira Abdullahi</LanguageString></BallotName><PartyId>…</PartyId><PersonId>…</PersonId></Candidate>; party is <Party Abbreviation="DEM"> (also REP, LIB, Indep, Nonprtycan, Non-partis, Other-part, Write-in, None). Measures: <BallotSelection xsi:type="BallotMeasureSelection" Selection="YES"> and Selection="NO" (ObjectId prefixed _YES / _NO).
district_field: In the title, zero-padded to two digits ("Representative to Congress - District 01"). Also derivable two other ways: the contest's <Code OtherType="ContestType" Value="Representative to Congress"/> gives the office without the district, and JurisdictionalScopeId points to a GpUnit of Type Congressional / StateSenate / StateHouse / Judicial; SequenceOrder ends in the district number (07000001). No plain district-number attribute.
